lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, with the most prominent clusters situated in the mid-flank region forming a coarse grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized lattice-like pattern on the mid-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient starting above the branchial region and extending posteriorly.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in pattern morphology from small, high-density punctate spots in the cephalic region to larger, widely spaced circular blobs posterior to the fifth gill slit.
